title: MSR-Align: Policy-Grounded Multimodal Alignment for Safety-Aware Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a subset of broader safety compliance by measuring the model's refusal rate to unsafe multimodal instructions requesting "discriminatory depictions." The evaluation uses a GPT-4V classifier to judge the percentage of safe responses on benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench and BeaverTails-V.
